notes.title: Demo Update v1.6 + Discord
notes.notes:
Since I released the last update to the demo, I have made some general improvements to the gameplay and visuals.  This update reflects the new standard of quality that I maintain throughout the entire game.

Changes Include :


Hand Animations (Its ALIVVEEE!)
Minor additions to level details
Interaction and gameplay tweaks
Replaced the forest in the first level with a cliffside to make it more obvious that you cant walk through it.
Misc. bug fixes and other technical mumbo jumbo


BTW, I started a discord server if you want to know more about the project or give any feedback.  I will start posting there once we gather enough people :)

Come Join the Discord!

Peace and much love,

~Dez
